name: Reizouko wa Shimete Kudasai!
original_name: 冷蔵庫は閉めてください！
source:
Hayashi Michi’s home refrigetator alarm has stopped working. His childhood friend and genius inventor, Esora Kotono, happens to be around and offers to fix it.

But depending on the sound source he chooses—be it an "SD card," a "USB drive," or a "DVD"—things take a rather strange turn...?
translation:
林导知家里的冰箱未关门提示音坏掉了。他的青梅竹马兼天才发明家绘空言乃恰好在场，自告奋勇地帮他修理。

然而，根据他挑选的音源介质不同——无论是“SD卡”“U盘”还是“DVD光盘”——事态都会朝着相当离谱的方向一路发展……？
